scoring_correction: Official task success is determined from internal official verifier test outcomes, not from the verifier-wrapper process exit code.

success_rule.pass_at_1: 1 only when every relevant internal official verifier test passes; otherwise 0.

reported_limitations: The validation and held-out sets have two tasks each.
Failure-mode counts are evidence rows, not independent trials.
Stored analysis reproduces corrected scoring without rerunning paid model calls.
